name: tools
description: Justin's tools as one pnpm workspace: Vite Plus runs build, test, check and dev across packages and serves the app that has a dev server.

scripts.skills:dev: vp run --cache @oneezy/skills-sync#build && pnpm --filter @oneezy/skills restore && pnpm --filter @oneezy/skills develop
scripts.check: vp run --filter "skills-viewer-web^..." build && vp check && vp run -r check
scripts.dev: vp run --cache --filter @oneezy/skills-sync --filter skills-viewer build && vp run --parallel --filter @oneezy/skills --filter skills-viewer-web dev
